subject: MedVantage private deployment: commitment & environment roadmap
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <epark@medvantagehealth.com>
Cc: Jose Morales <j.morales@medvantagehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: private/VPC sizing & target econ (next steps)

Hi Emily / Jose — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and two asks so we can lock pricing for your CFO/procurement loop: 

1) Volumes & usage assumptions (please confirm):
   - Expected steady-state tokens: 150M tokens/month
   - Peak: ~300M tokens/month (10% of requests)
   - Embeddings: ~25k/month (for search/semantic rank)

2) Target unit economics:
   - You indicated a target ~ $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens for on-prem/private licensing. Please confirm upper/lower bounds.

3) Environments & support:
   - Environments: prod + staging + dev (3 total) — please confirm whether dev can be shared across squads.
   - Support tier: are you expecting 24x7 critical (S1) or business-hours (S2)?

Next steps from our side: I will pull together a pricing anchor that includes: one-time private deployment license, monthly reserved capacity for the 3 envs, optional burst/overage rates, and two support tier options. I'll include a mutual action plan with deliverables and a DocuSign-ready term sheet.

If you can reply with the budget range procurement wants to see and confirm env count, I’ll have the anchor to you by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: private/VPC sizing & target econ (next steps)

Thanks Vanessa — great recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Volumes: those estimates look right. Our CFO will want a conservative forecast tied to committed spend; suggest we show 120M, 150M, and 250M tiers.
- Target $/1M tokens: procurement will likely push for ~= $750–$1,000 for a committed annual contract. They said anything above $1,200 will be hard to budget.
- Envs: confirmed 3 (prod/staging/dev). Dev can be shared across two squads.
- Support: we need S1 for prod (24x7), S2 for staging/dev.

Procurement asked: do you offer a blended unit price if we commit to a 12-month reserved capacity? Also please include any onboarding professional services estimates.

—Emily

Head of AI Product | MedVantage Health
epark@medvantagehealth.com

Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: private/VPC sizing & target econ (next steps)

Appreciate the clarity, Emily — that helps. Rafael / Sergio — looping you in to price out: 3 envs, steady-state 150M tokens/mo with tiered committed options (120 / 150 / 250M). Client prefers an annual reserved contract and wants a blended committed price around $750–$1,000 per 1M tokens; they indicated >$1,200 is a non-starter. They require:

- S1 for prod (24x7) and S2 for non-prod
- Embedding unit pricing for ~25k/mo (likely negligible vs gen tokens but include)
- Onboarding PS estimate (install, VPC peering, health-checks, runbook ops handoff)

I’ll draft a mutual action plan and attach the initial price anchor. Rafael — can you propose: a) one-time license fee bands (for private control plane), b) monthly reserved capacity pricing for each committed tier, c) overage per-token, and d) support band pricing? Also please flag any minimum term or infra assumptions we should call out (e.g., customer-provided firewalls, KMS).

Goal: get a single-slide anchor + M.A.P. to Emily & procurement by EOD 17 Sep.

Thanks — V

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Park <epark@medvantagehealth.com>, Jose Morales <j.morales@medvantagehealth.com>, procurement@medvantagehealth.com
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood price anchor & support bands for MedVantage (draft)

Team / Emily — attached is a pricing anchor for the three committed tiers plus our recommended support bands. Key highlights:

- One-time private license (control plane + deployment packaging): $120,000 — includes install scripts, base automation, and first-year upgrade rights.
- Monthly reserved capacity (gen tokens):
   * Tier A (120M committed): $900 per 1M tokens -> $108,000/month
   * Tier B (150M committed): $820 per 1M tokens -> $123,000/month
   * Tier C (250M committed): $750 per 1M tokens -> $187,500/month
- Overage: $1,500 per 1M for on-demand bursts (billed daily).
- Embeddings: flat rate $50 per 1k embeddings (first 50k bundled in Tier B/C).
- Support: S1 (prod 24x7) = $18,000/month; S2 (non-prod) = $4,000/month.
- Onboarding PS estimated at $45,000 (6–8 week engagement).

Assumptions & infra notes included in the attachment: customer must provide VPC peering, KMS access for key wrap, and at least /27 IP range for initial deployment. Term: 12 months minimum for reserved capacity.

[Attachment: Redwood-Private-Price-Anchor.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)]

Rafael Mendes
Director, Commercial Pricing | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Redwood price anchor & support bands for MedVantage (draft)

Rafael / Vanessa — thanks for the fast turnaround. Procurement and finance reviewed the anchor this morning. Quick notes: 

- Tier B (150M committed) at $820/1M is within range; finance prefers a blended $800/1M if we sign a 12-month commitment and include the onboarding PS at a fixed price.
- We need the S1/S2 split documented (S1 only for prod) and a clear SLA escalation path.
- Please provide a short credit note for potential invoice timing (invoice on day 1 of month for reserved capacity acceptable).

Next step: Can you send a term-sheet (DocuSign) reflecting: Tier B blended $800/1M, 12-month reserved commitment, one-time license fee reduced to $100,000 if we sign within 10 business days, and onboarding fixed at $45,000? If you can, add a single line for optional burst credits (pre-purchased at a discount).

If we get that, procurement will circulate internally and aim to countersign.

—Jose

VP, Platform Engineering | MedVantage Health
